name: Single-Leg Step-Down
steps: Stand sideways on the edge of a low sturdy box with one foot planted solidly and your free foot hovering off the side.
Brace your core, keep your pelvis level, and flex your hovering ankle so your toes stay pulled upward.
Bend your standing knee and hip slowly to lower your free heel gently until it lightly taps the floor.
Drive smoothly through your standing foot to return upright without pushing off the ground, then switch legs after one side.
tips: Keep your standing knee tracking straight over your middle toes rather than collapsing inward.
Touch your free heel feather-light to the floor without shifting weight onto it.
